entities.name: Hooraree
entities.description: Oldest of the four cat warrior tribes of the Sukurvian Desert, keepers of cat warrior lore.

entities.name: Efravans
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe, allies of the Hooraree.

entities.name: Sulaki
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe that exchanged cubs with the Hooraree.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Visited the Hooraree in 3336 AR and warned them of Johan's War.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Creator of the cat warriors, believed by the Hooraree to be a god.

entities.name: Scarwood elves
entities.description: Elves who claimed the Scarwood jungle and killed intruders.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War of the emperor from Tirras against the cat warriors and humans.

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Hooraree in 3336 AR and sees they have outgrown their oasis.
events.quote: When Jedit Ojanen visited them in 3336 AR , he realized that the Hooraree had outgrown their oasis

events.summary: Young Hooraree who tried to resettle the Scarwood disappeared, probably killed by the Scarwood elves.
events.quote: They were most likely killed by the Scarwood elves

events.summary: Once the menace is clear, the Hooraree join the Efravans and humans against the emperor from Tirras.
events.quote: they joined the Efravans and their human allies in the battle against the emperor from Tirras
